# Dhiren Bhardwaj

> Dhiren Bhardwaj (also spelled Dhiren Bharadwaj) is a Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) and SOC leader based in India, with 11+ years of experience across AT&T, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Microsoft, Deloitte, Mahindra Special Services Group and eSF Labs. He specialises in end-to-end incident response, digital forensics (disk, memory, mobile, email), cloud IR, threat hunting, SOC strategy and AI-augmented incident response.

## Experience
- AT&T — Senior DFIR Analyst (Mar 2026–present): leads DFIR investigations (phishing, malware, insider threat, unauthorized access); end-to-end incident management; endpoint/server/memory/cloud forensics with chain of custody.
- Kotak Mahindra Bank — Deputy Vice President, SOC & IR Lead (Feb 2024–Feb 2026): L2/L3 SOC investigations in regulated banking; email compromise & insider misuse forensics; IR runbooks & tabletop exercises; analyst mentoring; NIST CSF / MITRE ATT&CK alignment.
- Microsoft — Security Engineer II, Global Security Operations (Jan 2022–Jan 2024): global IR on Sentinel/Defender/MCAS/O365; IR automation → 25% SLA improvement, 50% manual effort reduction; KQL-driven investigations.
- Deloitte — Assistant Manager, Digital Forensics & Cyber Investigations (Nov 2017–Jan 2022): forensic engagements for enterprise/financial clients; memory forensics; built ELK-based log analysis platforms.
- Mahindra Special Services Group — Digital Forensic Analyst (Feb 2016–Oct 2017).
- eSF Labs — Digital Forensic Analyst (Jul 2014–Feb 2016): forensic imaging, RAM analysis, mobile forensics.

## Projects (AI security tooling)
- AI-Native DFIR Investigation Lab (flagship, completed, release pending): MCP (Model Context Protocol) server + simulated SIEM in SQLite (Azure AD/Sentinel/Defender-style tables) with 5 seeded attack scenarios (AiTM impossible travel T1078, password spray T1110.003, brute force T1110.001, suspicious app access T1528) and 7 agent-callable investigation tools for AI agents.
- AI-SOC Email Triage & Forensics (open source): Python tool parsing .eml files into structured JSON with Base64-safe attachment handling, then using Google Gemini for phishing/threat analysis. https://github.com/dhirenbhardwaj/SOC-DFIR-AI-Email-Triage
- MalNote — Intelligent Malware Note Generator (open source): SHA-256 hashing + local ClamAV scan + threat-intel correlation across VirusTotal, AlienVault OTX, ThreatFox and MalwareBazaar, generating Markdown DFIR notes with optional Gemini AI recommendations. https://github.com/dhirenbhardwaj/MalNoteGenerator
- Volatility Output Analysis using AI (open source): applies LLM analysis to Volatility memory-forensics output to surface suspicious processes and artifacts from RAM dumps. https://github.com/dhirenbhardwaj/Volatility-output-Analysis-using-AI-
- Digital Forensic Forest — long-running DFIR blog. https://digitalforensicforest.wordpress.com
